scope: Conceptual vocabulary; terms are not a list of implemented APIs. Current capabilities are specified in CAPABILITIES_AND_LIMITS.txt.

terms.definition: A versioned container for declared structure, state, provenance, and optional candidate overlays.
terms.does_not_mean: A physical organism, validated world model, or autonomous agent.

terms.definition: An addressable item in the declared graph with an identifier, optional type, attributes, and optional coordinates.
terms.does_not_mean: An atom, organ, sensor, actuator, or physical object unless a profile separately establishes that meaning.

terms.definition: A typed declared connection between two entities, with optional attributes such as strength, directionality, reversibility, or capability flags.
terms.does_not_mean: Transport, causation, force, communication, or physical coupling by default.

terms.definition: An ordered sequence of entities and/or relations used for traversal or reachability questions.
terms.does_not_mean: Material, energy, information, or signal actually moved along the route.

terms.definition: A named or indexed spatial/logical partition that can contain or address entities.
terms.does_not_mean: A biological body region; geometry and semantics are profile supplied.

terms.definition: A rule that assigns extents, bounds, membership, or coordinates to regions without prescribing domain-specific anatomy.
terms.does_not_mean: A fixed body ratio or biologically meaningful segmentation.

terms.definition: An optional ordered structural route used as a stable reference or coordination spine for other entities.
terms.does_not_mean: A literal spine, nervous system, identity carrier, or required topology.

terms.definition: A domain-specific vocabulary, metrics, build rules, and interpretations layered on the neutral core.
terms.does_not_mean: Core semantics or validated physics.

terms.definition: A reversible mapping from source identifiers/relations to alternate functional labels while preserving the original declarations.
terms.does_not_mean: Instantiation of the function named by the alias.

terms.definition: A separately addressable graph layer for unvalidated entities, relations, routes, or hypotheses that must not silently alter established state.
terms.does_not_mean: Accepted structure, measurement, mechanism, or truth.

terms.definition: An entity declared inside a candidate overlay whose unsupported fields remain null or absent.
terms.does_not_mean: An instantiated physical component.

terms.definition: A relation inside a candidate overlay, disabled for transport or state mutation unless an explicit later mechanism authorizes otherwise.
terms.does_not_mean: Flow, admission, sensing, exchange, or causation merely because the relation type uses those words.

terms.definition: An explicit representation of an unsupported value using null/absence rather than fabricated content.
terms.does_not_mean: Zero, false, impossible, or negligible.

terms.definition: A versioned serializable record of authorized current state, hashes, and restart metadata.
terms.does_not_mean: Complete dynamic history or proof that represented state exists physically.

terms.definition: An ordered declared transition record with sequence and provenance suitable for replay where the event type permits mutation.
terms.does_not_mean: An external observation unless explicitly designated as one.

terms.definition: A source-bound record stored outside model state by default, with explicit evidence status and provenance.
terms.does_not_mean: A model transition, measurement, or physical truth unless separately established.

terms.definition: A stable label and/or digest that identifies the source material supporting an observation, candidate, budget preview, or event.
terms.does_not_mean: Verification merely because an identifier exists.

terms.definition: An append-oriented persistence interface for ordered source-bound records, optionally with a chained head digest.
terms.does_not_mean: Consensus, validation, or immutable storage unless its implementation guarantees those properties.

terms.definition: A cryptographic content fingerprint used to compare declared artifacts, topology, state, or replay inputs.
terms.does_not_mean: Semantic equivalence, scientific validity, or authenticity of the original real-world source.

terms.definition: Metadata that binds an artifact or record to its source, version, digest, lineage ancestor, and transformation context.
terms.does_not_mean: A scientific claim about the source content.

terms.definition: A declaration of replay scope and the inputs/digests required to reproduce that scope.
terms.does_not_mean: Full dynamic replay unless that scope is explicitly implemented and verified.

terms.definition: A rule that blocks silent continuation or overwrite when source, topology, seed, mesh, height/profile, or resumability assumptions differ.
terms.does_not_mean: Automatic repair or migration.

terms.definition: A provenance-recorded operation that abandons a blocked/unresumable state only when an explicit nonempty reason is supplied.
terms.does_not_mean: Erasure of the historical blocked state.

terms.definition: A read-only reachability evaluation over declared relations, optional cuts, and caller-supplied gate conditions.
terms.does_not_mean: State mutation or physical transport.

terms.definition: An explicit caller-supplied condition used by a trace to hold or permit traversal at a declared boundary.
terms.does_not_mean: Real-world consent, safety, compatibility, sensing, or valve state unless independently measured and mapped.

terms.definition: A non-mutating arithmetic conservation check over caller-supplied quantities and a reachable candidate route.
terms.does_not_mean: Measured capacity, flow, metabolism, energy transfer, or material transfer.

terms.definition: A profile-defined scalar or structured measure whose semantics, units, bounds, and evidence source must be declared outside the neutral core.
terms.does_not_mean: A universal Atlas property such as coherence, protection, freedom, or noise.

terms.definition: An external visual, document, dataset, or artifact described by provenance metadata without mutating model state.
terms.does_not_mean: Authority to set geometry, physical budgets, identity, or mechanism unless separately declared.

terms.definition: A replayable finite sequence of declared stages or anchors where each transition records predecessor and result digests.
terms.does_not_mean: Biological development, elapsed time, growth physics, or a continuous dynamical model.

terms.definition: An optional explicit transition that returns selected profile state toward a declared baseline after a prior transition.
terms.does_not_mean: Healing, biological recovery, or guaranteed restoration.

terms.definition: A boundary component that translates external persistence, file, or domain representations into neutral Atlas records without changing core semantics.
terms.does_not_mean: Implicit authority to reinterpret or validate imported data.
